searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: What you'd type into Google Maps, one per line, e.g. dentist, plumber, roofing contractor. Use distinct terms: near-duplicates add time, not leads.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, region or ZIP, e.g. Austin, TX or 33614. Leave empty if your search terms already include a place.

maxPlacesPerSearch.title: Max places per search term
maxPlacesPerSearch.description: Leads to collect per search term. Google Maps lists about 120 places per search. When you ask for more and a search comes back full, that area is split into closer views automatically, up to this max (500). The default of 20 does not split.

extractContacts.title: Extract emails & socials from websites
extractContacts.description: Visits each business's website (home, contact and about pages) to collect emails, phone numbers and social profiles. Adds $0.001 per place, charged only when the site loads. Turn off for places-only data at $0.003 each.

maxContactPages.title: Max website pages per business
maxContactPages.description: How many pages per website to scan for contacts: home page first, then contact and about pages. More pages can find more emails but take a little longer.

maxReviews.title: Max reviews per place
maxReviews.description: Keep up to this many Google reviews per place (0–8). 0 leaves reviews empty. This doesn't open extra review pages.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Only keep places rated at or above this many stars (0 keeps everything).

skipClosed.title: Skip closed places
skipClosed.description: Leave out places Google marks as temporarily or permanently closed.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code for Google Maps results, e.g. en, es, de, fr.

startUrls.title: Google Maps search URLs (optional)
startUrls.description: Optional. Paste Google Maps search URLs to scrape them in addition to the search terms.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: The Apify datacenter proxy works for most runs. If it cannot be reached, the run continues with a direct connection instead of hanging. Switch to residential only if you see blocks.
